title.en: From Turing Machines to Large Language Models

summary.zh-CN: 从可计算性、表示学习与语言预测出发，比较大模型形成的关键方法与条件，讨论任务迁移的依据及其进入 Agent 系统后的局限。
summary.en: Examine computability, representation learning, and language prediction to understand how large models develop reusable capabilities and what remains unresolved in agent systems.
